settings.editor: Glacier West delivers specialized design-build construction for cold storage, food processing, community, medical and laboratory, industrial, and institutional facilities across Canada.

settings.title: Design-build for facilities where performance, compliance, and efficiency matter.

settings.editor: With over 30 years of design-build experience and more than 3 million sq. ft. completed, we bring the expertise needed to deliver specialized environments built for compliance, efficiency, and long-term performance.
From new builds and expansions to facility upgrades and specialized conversions, we help clients bring complex projects from concept to completion.
Five specialized sectors, one coordinated design-build team.
Complex facilities require more than construction expertise. They require an understanding of how the building needs to perform once it’s operational.

Glacier West brings together design, planning, engineering, and construction expertise to address operational workflows, regulatory requirements, building performance, infrastructure, and long-term facility needs throughout the design-build process.

Our approach can incorporate energy-efficient building envelopes, mechanical system optimization, sustainable material selection, and other practical strategies that improve efficiency, reduce operating costs, and support long-term facility performance.
Answers to the questions we hear most often from facility owners and operators.
